hero.title: <web-developer>
hero.text:
I am a programmer with a passion for web development and tackling diverse programming challenges.

Always eager to explore new technologies, I’m committed to improving my skills and continually striving for mastery in everything I build.

list.title: Greek Geek
list.text: A gamified fitness tracker that motivates users to do pushups and compete with friends.
list.description:
Greek Geek is a mobile-first fitness app that encourages users to stay active by tracking pushups and joining friendly competitions.

Users can set daily goals, view progress, and compete in 'arenas' with friends. The app includes pushup history, performance charts, and notification features.

I designed the UI in Figma and developed the frontend using Vue, with Firebase handling authentication, data storage, and deployment.

list.title: Realms World
list.text: Contributed React components to Realms.World, a fully on-chain game ecosystem built on Starknet.
list.description:
Worked on the frontend of Realms.World, a decentralized gaming platform powered by the Starknet Layer 2 blockchain. My contributions focused on building React components and pages, including a promotional landing page for 'Blob Arena'—a game in the Realms ecosystem. 

This page was promoted via a QR code displayed in the octagon during a live MMA Knight fight. In a later video, Joe Rogan discussed the event (find the link bellow), and in the background, the Blob Arena character symbol and QR code were clearly visible. 

The platform also features strategy games like Eternum, where players interact with AI agents and blockchain-based resources using the $LORDS token.

list.title: Food order app
list.text: A mobile-focused food ordering UI built from Figma designs.
list.description:
This frontend-only project features a sleek food ordering interface tailored for mobile devices. I was provided with a UI mockup and replicated it with pixel-perfect accuracy using Vue and SCSS.

The app simulates a real ordering experience, with interactive item selection, error handling, and visual order confirmations. It highlights my ability to interpret designs and implement responsive user interfaces.

list.title: Portfolio page
list.text: A responsive personal portfolio showcasing projects and frontend skills.
list.description:
This website serves as my personal portfolio. I designed it in Figma and developed it using Vue 3 and SCSS. It features animations, a categorized project list, and mobile-friendly design.

The site is hosted on Firebase and reflects my strengths in component-based architecture, visual design, and responsive layout implementation.

list.title: Hudlajf website
list.text: A Nuxt-based marketing website developed during my internship.
list.description:
This project was completed during my internship at Hudlajf, where I collaborated with a designer, marketing team, and tech lead to build a clean, conversion-oriented website.

I used Nuxt 2 to implement the frontend, ensuring fast performance and smooth integration of design and content. This experience helped me grow in team collaboration, communication, and frontend project ownership.

list.title: Gabi tvoja lepotilnica
list.text: A personal website for a local nail salon, built in Vue and Nuxt.
list.description:
I designed and developed this website for a friend's nail salon. After gathering requirements and creating the UI in Figma, I built the site using Nuxt 2 and styled it with SCSS.

The site is responsive and highlights the salon’s services in a clean and modern layout. This project shows my ability to understand client needs and deliver fully customized web solutions.

list.title: Panna cakes
list.text: A bakery website built in Next.js with integrated email order requests.
list.description:
Panna Cakes is a responsive bakery website developed using Next.js for a friend’s cake business. The site allows customers to browse cake options and send order inquiries via email.

I used React for interactive elements, Bootstrap for layout, and Sass for styling. This project served as a practical introduction to Next.js and demonstrated my ability to build functional business websites using React.
